purpose: PJ1 actual managed harness natural-language call selection draft; no runtime call evidence is claimed here.

source.schema_semantics: canonical copies are the exact selected schema objects from this index; IDs are server:name.

selection.rationale: Nine tools span read-only discovery/history, repository mutations with independently observable effects, SQLite catalog/query, and browser navigation/content/evaluation. It exercises different transport and authority categories without calling every advertised tool.
selection.coverage_limit: Only these nine calls are proposed. Selection is not evidence that all 92 schemas work, that Gateway policy approved them, or that endpoint enforcement blocked bypass.

alias_resolution.label: DBHub (@bytebase/dbhub)
alias_resolution.note: The product identity is DBHub, but canonical tool IDs use server ID sqlite. PJ1 must match this actual configured server ID; do not rename IDs to dbhub without fresh tools/list evidence.

selection.alternatives_and_selection: Git add+commit exercise real write behavior, unlike selecting four read-only Git tools. execute_sql is intentionally selected despite its write-capable/raw SQL contract because it is a high-value authority check; the prompt restricts the call to a single SELECT and uses only the isolated synthetic SQLite. browser_evaluate exposes arbitrary page JavaScript, so the proposed call returns only synthetic fixture title/text; this remains a high-risk capability and must not run against any non-fixture page.

prompts.text: 합성 시험 저장소의 현재 상태를 확인해줘. 변경 파일, staged/unstaged/untracked 항목과 clean 여부만 요약해줘. 실제 프로젝트나 다른 저장소는 열지 마.
같은 합성 시험 저장소에서 최근 커밋 3개를 한 줄 형식으로 보여줘. patch나 서명 상세는 요청하지 마.
합성 시험 저장소의 사전 준비된 notes.md 파일 하나만 stage해줘. 전체 파일, ignored 파일, 다른 경로는 추가하지 마.
prompts.effect_and_recovery: If the run stops before commit, verify only the task-local index contains notes.md, then discard/recreate the disposable task repo to its recorded baseline. Do not reset any other repo.

prompts.text: 방금 stage한 합성 notes.md만 커밋해줘. 메시지는 "test: PJ1 synthetic MCP harness"로 하고 amend, allow-empty, hook 우회는 사용하지 마. 실제 프로젝트에는 커밋하지 마.
prompts.effect_and_recovery: Capture new HEAD and committed path with independent git log/status; then stop the test server and remove/recreate only the verified task-owned disposable repo. Record cleanup outcome. Do not amend, revert, or reset any non-fixture repo.

prompts.text: 격리된 합성 SQLite 데이터베이스에서 table 객체 이름만 찾아줘. 상세 내용은 names 수준, 최대 20개로 제한하고 업무 DB에는 연결하지 마.
prompts.effect_and_recovery: Read-only metadata query; no restoration required.

prompts.text: 격리된 합성 SQLite DB에서 SELECT id, label FROM demo_items ORDER BY id LIMIT 10 만 실행해줘. 변경·다중 SQL문·ATTACH·파일이나 확장 기능은 사용하지 마.

expected_arguments.sql: SELECT id, label FROM demo_items ORDER BY id LIMIT 10

prompts.effect_and_recovery: Single SELECT; compare result with independent SQLite query; no DB change expected, verify table row count unchanged.

prompts.text: 하네스가 제공한 정확한 task-local loopback 합성 fixture URL {{PLAYWRIGHT_FIXTURE_URL}} 로만 이동해줘. 다른 URL로 이동하거나 폼 제출, 링크 클릭은 하지 마.
prompts.effect_and_recovery: Navigation changes browser state; after recording exact origin/result, navigate back to the fixture start or close the isolated task profile.

prompts.text: 현재 열린 합성 fixture 페이지의 접근성 snapshot을 응답으로 반환해줘. filename은 지정하지 말고 로컬에 파일을 저장하지 마.
prompts.effect_and_recovery: Response-only snapshot; filename omitted so no file recovery required.

prompts.text: 현재 합성 fixture 페이지에서 읽기 전용으로 document.title과 document.body.innerText만 반환해줘. DOM 수정, 이벤트 발생, 네트워크 요청, 파일 저장은 하지 마.
prompts.effect_and_recovery: No state mutation is intended; compare returned values to the fixture and confirm no filename/network side effect.

tools.name: git_status

schema.name: git_status
schema.title: Git Status
schema.description: Show the working tree status including staged, unstaged, and untracked files.

path.description: Path to the Git repository. Defaults to session working directory set via git_set_working_dir.

includeUntracked.description: Include untracked files in the output.

success.description: Indicates if the operation was successful.

upstream.description: Upstream ref the current branch is tracking (if any).

isClean.description: True if working directory is clean (no staged, unstaged, or untracked changes). When includeUntracked is false, untracked files are excluded from this check.

stagedChanges.description: Changes that have been staged for the next commit.

unstagedChanges.description: Changes in the working directory that have not been staged.

untrackedFiles.description: Files in the working directory not tracked by git.

conflictedFiles.description: Files with merge conflicts that need resolution.

tools.limitation: 스키마 광고·보수적 권한 상한 분류; 개별 도구 전체 실행 또는 관리 엔드포인트 집행 증거 아님

tools.name: git_log

schema.name: git_log
schema.title: Git Log
schema.description: View commit history with optional filtering by author, date range, file path, or commit message pattern.

path.description: Path to the Git repository. Defaults to session working directory set via git_set_working_dir.

maxCount.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-1000).

skip.description: Number of items to skip for pagination.

since.description: Show commits more recent than a specific date (ISO 8601 format).

until.description: Show commits older than a specific date (ISO 8601 format).

author.description: Filter commits by author name or email pattern.

grep.description: Filter commits by message pattern (regex supported).

branch.description: Show commits from a specific branch or ref (defaults to current branch).

filePath.description: Show commits that affected a specific file path. Must not start with "-".

oneline.description: Abbreviated output: return only hash, shortHash, and subject per commit. Significantly reduces response size.

stat.description: Include file change statistics for each commit.

patch.description: Include the full diff patch for each commit.

showSignature.description: Show GPG signature verification information for each commit.

success.description: Indicates if the operation was successful.

subject.description: First line of the commit message.

refs.description: References (branches, tags) pointing to this commit.

stat.description: File change statistics (when stat option is used).

patch.description: Full diff patch (when patch option is used).

totalCount.description: Total number of commits returned (may be limited by maxCount).

note.description: Set when filters returned zero commits. Echoes the criteria and suggests broadening so callers can self-correct without inspecting the request.

tools.limitation: 스키마 광고·보수적 권한 상한 분류; 개별 도구 전체 실행 또는 관리 엔드포인트 집행 증거 아님

tools.name: git_add

schema.name: git_add
schema.title: Git Add
schema.description: Stage files for commit. Add file contents to the staging area (index) to prepare for the next commit.

path.description: Path to the Git repository. Defaults to session working directory set via git_set_working_dir.

paths.description: Array of file or directory paths to stage (relative to repository root). Use ["."] to stage all changes. Paths must not start with "-" — use "./-name" for filenames starting with a dash. Can be omitted when all or update is true.

update.description: Stage only modified and deleted files (skip untracked files).

success.description: Indicates if the operation was successful.

staged_changes.description: All staged changes after this operation.

is_clean.description: Whether working directory is clean (ready to commit).

tools.name: git_commit

schema.name: git_commit
schema.title: Git Commit
schema.description:
Create a new commit with staged changes in the repository. Records a snapshot of the staging area with a commit message.

**Commit Message Format:**
Pass commit messages as JSON string parameters. Multi-line messages are supported using standard JSON string escaping.

**Examples:**
- Single line: { "message": "feat: add user authentication" }
- Multi-line: { "message": "feat: add user authentication\n\nImplemented OAuth2 flow with JWT tokens.\nAdded tests for login and logout." }

Note: Do not use bash heredoc syntax. Literal escape sequences (\n, \t) in the message string are automatically normalized to their actual characters.

path.description: Path to the Git repository. Defaults to session working directory set via git_set_working_dir.

author.description: Override commit author (defaults to git config).

amend.description: Amend the previous commit instead of creating a new one. Use with caution.

allowEmpty.description: Allow creating a commit with no changes.

filesToStage.description: File paths to stage before committing (atomic stage+commit operation). Entries must not start with "-".

success.description: Indicates if the operation was successful.

commitHash.description: SHA-1 hash of the created commit.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp when the commit was created.

filesChanged.description: Number of files changed in this commit.

committedFiles.description: List of files that were committed.

signed.description: Whether the commit was signed. False when GIT_SIGN_COMMITS=false or when signing was attempted and fell back to unsigned on failure.

signingWarning.description: Populated only when signing was requested but failed, and the commit was created unsigned as a fallback.

preconditions_for_live_run: Use only the newly provisioned PJ1 managed harness and exact advertised server/tool IDs; confirm fresh harness identity and managed active/compliant state before calls.

Before P1-P4, confirm Git session working directory points to a task-owned synthetic repo with expected baseline and notes.md; do not infer a safe scope from GIT_BASE_DIR. P3/P4 effects are intended and durable inside that disposable fixture, and must be independently observed via HEAD/status/log.
Before P5-P6, confirm the configured sqlite/DBHub DSN is the task-local synthetic database, expected table demo_items exists, and no production/employee database URL is in use.
Before P7-P9, replace {{PLAYWRIGHT_FIXTURE_URL}} with the exact loopback URL of the task-owned fixture. Confirm the current page remains that fixture before browser_evaluate.
Use fresh natural-language turns in the managed harness; parent/operator reviews Gateway decisions and ledger/log correlation. A protocol-only or local direct call does not count as this PJ1 test.

known_schema_mismatches.fact: Canonical tools/list input uses maxCount (camelCase), not historical helper name max_count. The prompt avoids raw arguments, but parent should validate model-generated arguments against this schema.
DBHub implementation is identified as server sqlite in the selected schema index. Match the configured alias and schema; the product label DBHub is not the protocol server ID.

Schema requires url string but gives no fixture-origin restriction. The natural-language prompt alone is not a security boundary; actual PJ1 runtime must constrain target/profile and operator must confirm the URL.

limitations: Input schemas and risk IDs are copied from a previously captured schema inventory; actual PJ1 tools/list and contract approval may differ and must be checked immediately before execution.
Natural-language wording cannot prove which tool/model arguments were generated; inspect the actual tool invocation and Gateway decision logs.
The 92-tool inventory is a schema inventory, not 92 verified calls. E12/E13 remain in their prior status; this selection does not mark them complete.
